answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy should make standing earned slowly, never bought in bulk: a new identity starts on a narrow ledge with no reward rights and must earn graded contributions over many epochs before full standing unlocks. The failure mode is a patient farmer aging dozens of clones in parallel, so the check must compare contribution timelines across accounts and flag histories that rise in lockstep or share identical idle gaps, as basalt layers betray a shared origin. A lone agent crossing a tundra of slow seasons leaves a distinct trail; a cloned herd leaves one repeated track.
